title: Competition and Reputation in an Online Marketplace: Evidence from Airbnb
eligible_reason: Single common shock (San Francisco short-term-rental registration enforcement, post_nov17_1 for all listings at the same snapshot) interacted with a continuous listing-level exposure (SIMUL_CHANGE_*km_sept17_all, simulated change in nearby competitors). Main results are IV: xtivreg rating i.year i.week trend i.post_nov17_1 (log_N_LISTING_*km = post x SIMUL_CHANGE), fe (TABLES_IV.do); reduced form and first stage use the same continuous interaction plus a linear time trend; OLS uses the continuous log number of competitors. The event study (EVENT_STUDY.do) interacts the continuous exposure with snapshot dummies. Not staggered, treatment continuous, IV.
design_notes: Stata 17 xtreg/xtivreg, fe vce(cluster listing_id), listing x snapshot panel (Inside Airbnb SF, May 2015 - Oct 2019). Robustness: time window, radius, alternative dates, Moscone event, instant booking, professional hosts.
data_files_note: README: raw Inside Airbnb San Francisco snapshots must be requested from insideairbnb.com; the extracted package contains only do files, READMEs and a log (no data or processed files present).
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex abstract. Single-date regulation with continuous exposure in an IV design; data not shipped.
